build_radius_graph_from_atomic_data: build a radius graph from AtomicData using biknn_radius_graph and return GraphAttentionData with edge features
create_edge_distance_expansion: create edge distance expansion using GaussianSmearing, SigmoidSmearing, LinearSigmoidSmearing, or SiLUSmearing basis functions
compute_node_direction_expansion: compute node direction expansion vectors from edge directions and neighbor masks with configurable lmax
generate_attention_mask_with_angle_embed: generate attention masks with optional angle embeddings for graph attention using edge direction vectors
construct_graph_attention_data: construct a GraphAttentionData object with atomic numbers, edge features, attention masks, and padding for GNN inference
